items.q: What is the typical engineering timeline for a custom engagement?
items.a: Our senior engineering teams deploy in high-velocity, milestone-gated sprints. Production MVPs and dedicated internal tools typically ship in 3 to 6 weeks. Complex enterprise architectures, multi-agent AI ecosystems, and distributed cloud systems range from 8 to 12 weeks. Every engagement has a guaranteed delivery date defined during technical discovery.

items.q: What does an enterprise engagement actually cost?
items.a: Every engagement is scoped with milestone-based transparent deliverables, sprint architecture, and zero surprise billing. Bespoke internal tools and production MVPs typically range from ₹1.5L to ₹3L. Growth-stage software systems — custom cloud architectures, multi-agent AI pipelines, and enterprise automation — range from ₹3L to ₹5L. Scaled enterprise platforms, high-throughput microservices, and multi-region infrastructure are scoped through technical discovery (₹5L+). Schedule a technical discovery session for a detailed architectural delivery roadmap.

items.q: What if I need changes after the project is delivered?
items.a: We offer an annual maintenance contract (20% of the initial project cost) covering platform updates, security patches, and minor bug fixes. For larger feature additions, we scope and quote them as separate change requests — you're never locked out of your own product.

items.q: How do I know I'll actually own my app or software?
items.a: We believe in complete transparency. We've published a due-diligence checklist covering code ownership, app store accounts, and hosting. We assign full source code and IP to you upon final payment, and give you direct access to all infrastructure.
